title: What happens if you accidentally hit the ball twice in one swing?
question: During a tricky chip, your club accidentally hits the ball twice in the same swing. How many strokes do you count and is there a penalty?

choices.text: Count two strokes and add a penalty stroke
Count one stroke with no penalty
Count one stroke and add a penalty stroke
Ignore the shot and play again without penalty

explanation: If you double-hit the ball in a single swing, it counts as just one stroke and there is no penalty.

juniorVersion.title: What if my club hits the ball twice, but I only swung once?
juniorVersion.question: You try a hard chip shot, but your club taps the ball two times in the same swing. What should you do?

choices.text: Count two hits and add an extra penalty point
Count only one hit with no extra points
Count one hit and add an extra penalty point
Don’t count the shot; play again for free

juniorVersion.explanation: If you hit the ball twice but only took one swing, it just counts as one shot. You don’t get any extra penalty.

vocabulary.simpleMeaning: A short hit to make the ball go in the air and land on the green.
Extra points added for breaking a rule.

juniorVersion.teachingTip: You can show this with a slow-motion video or by having kids practise slow chip shots, so they see when the club might hit the ball more than once.
likelyMisconceptions: Kids may think you have to add extra points if the club taps the ball twice.
Some might feel like they need to replay the shot, but they do not.
